parameters.content:
## Steam Game Reviews & Playtime Extractor

**Actor:** [Steam Game Reviews & Playtime Extractor](https://apify.com/dataspryva/steam-game-reviews-and-playtime-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/steam-game-reviews-and-playtime-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `appIds` (array)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `gameNames` (array)
- `maxReviews` (integer)
- `maxGames` (integer)
- `reviewType` (string)
- `language` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `helpfulWithinDays` (integer)
- `purchaseType` (string)
- `minPlaytimeHours` (integer)

### Output fields
- `gameTitle` (Game)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewText` (Review)
- `authorName` (Author)
- `authorSteamId` (Author ID)
- `authorPlaytimeForever` (Playtime (hrs))
- `votesHelpful` (Helpful Votes)
- `timestampCreated` (Date)
- `language` (Language)
- `steamPurchase` (Steam Purchase)
- `primarilySteamDeck` (Steam Deck)

description: Steam game reviews scraper: runs the Steam Game Reviews & Playtime Extractor Apify Actor, returns gameTitle, rating, reviewText, authorName, authorPlaytimeForever and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
